title: Do not suggest names ending with the suffix arium
abstract: When generating or recommending new names for projects, products, applications, repositories, tools, or other user-named entities, do not propose candidate names whose final letters are 'arium', regardless of letter case.

source.reference: Proposed naming-preference prohibition; source language and private conversation not reproduced

conflict_tracking.intention: Compare this prohibition with opposing permissions or obligations to suggest names across overlapping naming contexts.
conflict_tracking.known_limitation: Existing conflict analysis compares same normalized predicate and scope; it does not reason over arbitrary suffix constraints, so semantically conflicting naming rules may need manual review or a separately authorized predicate/constraint extension.

remarks: Queue-only proposed prohibition; it does not authorize normalization, publication, website changes, or downstream engineering. Do not reproduce private or emotional language in the public repository.
